messages:
anna_sales: Heads-up: Prospect Solace wants a POC with a committed capacity option. They expect steady ~300 QPS and marketing spikes up to ~1.8k QPS (chat + embeddings). Need recommended reserved GPU count, autoscale/fallback plan, and preheat estimate.
mike_oncall: Region and model pinned? Also any compliance asks?
renee_eng: They're pinning redwood/llm-7b-quantized in us-east-1, HIPAA in scope (KMS + audit). Traffic: ~60% chat (avg 140 tokens), 40% embeddings (512 dim). Peak concurrency ~1200.
chad_solution: Pricing request: predictable committed monthly price + a capped burst pool for campaigns. They want explicit preheat add-on so p99 doesn't tank at campaign start.
renee_eng: Quick sizing: mixed effective throughput ~60 qps/GPU on A100-80. For steady 300 -> reserve 5 GPUs. For peak 1800 -> ~30 GPUs total. Recommend reserve 5 + burst up to 25.
mike_oncall: Autoscale proposal: min_nodes=5, max_nodes=30, scale_up target ~60s, scale_down cooldown ~10min to avoid thrash. Add a burst soft-cap that triggers throttling policies after sustained overage.
chad_solution: Fallback idea: route overflow to llm-7b-q4f16 when saturated. Use a canary (10%) to validate quality, rollback if eval drift >2%. Make fallback percentages contract-configurable.
renee_eng: Preheat estimate: warming common KV prefixes ~200M tokens -> ~3 GPU-hours per region. Recommend 4-6 hour preheat window plus a one-time preheat reservation for campaign starts. Cross-region replication doubles warm cost.
mike_oncall: Ops runbook items: preheat checklist, KV-hit dashboards, tail-latency alarms, throttle recipe, and incident contacts. Also require KMS key ARN and SOC2 attestation for onboarding.
anna_sales: Great. Can we frame pricing as: 5 reserved GPUs @monthly X, burst-pool credits up to 25 GPUs at burst-rate Y/hr, optional preheat block (6 GPU-hrs) at flat fee Z, Private/VPC add-on for KMS/audit?
chad_solution: Yes. I'll draft a short engineering appendix (per-GPU throughput table at 5/10/20/30 nodes, tail latency estimates, fallback quality delta) and a pricing exhibit with three scenarios: steady, campaign, and worst-case sustained.
ops-bot: Created ticket #PR-10088: "Solace POC 1: sizing + preheat runbook + KMS legal wording" assigned to renee_eng, mike_oncall, chad_solution, due 2026-04-07. :white_check_mark:
anna_sales: Thanks team. I'll schedule a customer sync Wed 2pm ET and include Legal for the KMS language.
All: "Thanks ":thumbsup: "will finalize appendix and pricing.""
